description: Close fenced delta replay review findings
no_spec_change_rationale: The materializer adopts the existing requirement reader fence rules and tests the existing replay contract. The reader behavior and normative requirements stay the same.
acceptance_criteria: The existing requirement reader and the canonical materializer apply the same fence rules. A malformed backtick opener leaves both requirement and spec section headings visible. Valid fenced examples leave the intended block boundaries intact.
Already-applied checks accept a removal when only a fenced example remains and a modification when the canonical block already carries the new body.

answers.constraints: Keep one fence recognizer, preserve original byte ranges and headings, and retain approved archive evidence.
